data.title: Do employers value University of Phoenix graduates? The Harris Poll survey finds 98% report satisfaction
data.description: A recent study by The Harris Poll on behalf of University of Phoenix revealed that 97% of managers overseeing graduates from the institution express willingness to consider hiring individuals holding a degree from University of Phoenix in upcoming recruitment processes. This promising statistic signifies a strong level of confidence in the credibility and quality of education provided by the university. The study was conducted in Phoenix and the results were released on September 14, 2026. This data reflects positive prospects for University of Phoenix alumni in securing future employment opportunities.

data.title: Charles Zhang Ranked #1 in the Nation on Barron's 2026 Top 100 Independent Advisors
data.description: For the fifth time overall and the fourth consecutive year, Charles Zhang, CFP®, MBA, MS, Founder and President of Zhang Financial based in PORTAGE, Mich., achieved the top ranking in 2026 on Barron's list. data.title: MEMX Group Successfully Launches MX2 Options
data.description: In New York, MEMX Group, a technology-focused exchange operator established by industry members to enhance investor benefits, reported the successful debut and initial trading session of MX2 Options, its fresh customer priority, pro-rata options exchange. MX2 Options, launched recently, broadens MEMX Group’s options trading functionalities, offering market participants entry to a customer priority, pro-rata allocation strategy. This model allows for order execution based on size and introduces alternative methods for optimal trading.
